subject: English
stimulus: (a) A cobbler was happy to ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯. (b) He had a neighbour having ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯. (c) He wanted to help him by ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯. (d) ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ the cobbler lost happiness. (e) But for his money ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) A cobbler was happy to live by mending shoes. (b) He had a neighbour having a vast property. (c) He wanted to help him by lending money. (d) As he grew rich, the cobbler lost happiness. (e) But for his money, he was happy.
